user.title: Add Bose SoundTouch
user.description: Enter your speaker host and optional volume fade settings. Duration is in milliseconds; 0 means immediate.

init.title: Volume fade
init.description: Fade each new HA volume request from the speaker's actual volume. Duration is in milliseconds; 0 means immediate. HA keeps enforcing the last target regardless of this setting.
